story.iWant: the LED to reflect the recovered button state immediately after boot
story.soThat: I can see the module's state as soon as it powers on
story.tasks: - Load button state from QSPI during main() initialization - Set LED (CV_OUT_2) to match loaded state before AudioCallback starts - Ensure LED = 5V when overdrive enabled, 0V when disabled - Handle QSPI load failure with safe default (LED OFF) - Verify no LED flicker during boot

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - Button state loaded from QSPI during main() initialization - LED (CV_OUT_2) set to match loaded state before AudioCallback starts - LED = 5V when overdrive enabled, 0V when disabled - No LED flicker during boot - LED state correct even if QSPI load fails (safe default: OFF) - LED continues to sync with button toggles during operation

ideas.idea: Test 1: Save overdrive ON state, power cycle, verify LED immediately ON at boot
Test 2: Save overdrive OFF state, power cycle, verify LED immediately OFF at boot
Test 3: Corrupt QSPI settings, power on, verify LED OFF (safe default) with no crash
Test 4: Press button 20 times, verify LED toggles immediately on every press
Test 5: Observe LED during boot sequence, verify no flicker or intermediate states
